svg.title: ANNIE MC production: GENIE, anniedirt, WCSim, MC toolchain
svg.desc: Side view along the beam. A BNB neutrino interacts in the rock (GENIE); Geant4 carries the outgoing muon through the rock to the tank (anniedirt); the detector response in the FMV, tank and MRD is simulated (WCSim); ToolAnalysis turns the hits into ntuples (MC toolchain). Below: the output file of each stage and the mcprod steps used to run each stage.
svg.text: ANNIE MC production: one neutrino, four stages
Side view along the beam, not to scale. Every run N goes through all four stages, one grid job per run and stage.
